PRADEEP JAISWAL

LEAD / SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST | PROCESS & OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE | DIGITAL & INTELLIGENT AUTOMATION

Delhi, India  | 9999736141|   prad33pjaiswal@gmail.com |  linkedin.com/in/pradeepjaiswal23

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Results-driven Lead Business Analyst and Process & Operational Excellence professional with 12+ years of experience across Banking, Housing Finance, Credit Cards, Payments, E-Commerce and BPO/ITES. Experienced in leading regulatory-driven transformation, KYC/AML change, customer onboarding, CRM/data migration, LOS/LMS implementations, process re-engineering and intelligent automation. Certified CBAP and Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with strong capability in BRD/FRD/SRS, program governance, stakeholder management, UAT, KPI/MIS governance, data modelling, SQL/Power BI and cross-functional transformation. Hands-on exposure to GenAI, RPA, conversational AI, Salesforce CRM, API integrations and digital customer journeys, with a track record of measurable TAT, cost, quality, NPS/CSAT and control improvements.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis BRD/FRD/SRS • Requirements Elicitation • User Stories • Process Mapping • UAT • SDLC Program & Change Program Governance • Transformation Roadmaps • Risk/Issue Tracking • Change Management • Agile/Scrum Banking & BFSI KYC/AML • Customer Onboarding • Payments & Reconciliation • Lending • LOS/LMS • Credit Cards • Collections CRM & Data CRM Strategy • Salesforce • Data Migration • Data Modelling • Dimensional Structures • API Integrations Process Excellence Lean Six Sigma • DMAIC/DMADV • VSM • Kaizen • RCA • BPMS • RCSA • ICFR • Audit Readiness Digital & AI GenAI/LLM • Conversational AI • Chatbots • RPA • AI-assisted Analytics • Omnichannel Transformation Analytics SQL • Power BI • Tableau • Advanced Excel • KPI/OKR/BSC • MIS Dashboards • Business Metrics Leadership Senior Stakeholder Management • Cross-functional Leadership • Green Belt Coaching • Vendor Governance Tools JIRA • MS Project • Visio • Miro • Draw.io • Minitab • UAT/Defect Tracking

SELECTED TRANSFORMATION & BLACK BELT PROJECTS

GenAI-Augmented KYC & AML Process Re-engineering

Applied DMAIC to map KYC onboarding TAT bottlenecks and integrated LLM-based document classification to auto-extract and validate identity fields, reducing manual review effort by ~60%.

Deployed conversational AI for routine onboarding clarifications, reducing agent-handled inbound enquiries by ~35%.

Established SPC/control dashboards aligned to RBI standards; reported zero repeat audit findings post-go-live and ~45% onboarding cycle-time compression.

CRM Migration & SLA Adherence Optimization – Salesforce + AI Triage

Led enterprise CRM migration and redesigned complaint workflows, data structures, roles, escalation matrices and governance.

Integrated AI ticket triage/auto-routing and BPMS dashboards, reducing mis-routing by ~70%, resolution time by ~50% and AHT by ~28%.

Digital Home Loan Journey – Lead Generation to Disbursal

Designed a paperless home-loan journey across lead capture, onboarding, KYC, underwriting, sanction and disbursal, eliminating ~18 manual handoffs.

Integrated AI document verification, LOS/LMS, BRE decisioning, Aadhaar OTP/DigiLocker and borrower self-service; reduced login-to-disbursal TAT from 45–48 days to ~20 days.

VAN Payment & Reconciliation Transformation

Led RBI-compliant VAN implementation with control frameworks, exception handling and reconciliation logic, reducing manual reconciliation effort by ~40%.

Applied root-cause analysis and automation to reconciliation failures, achieving ~85% straight-through processing and reducing processing time from 4 hours to under 30 minutes.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Project Manager / Senior Business Analyst (Senior Manager) | SysArc Infomatix Pvt Ltd
Apr 2026 – Present | Delhi

Support complex LOS change initiatives for Punjab National Bank across multiple stakeholder groups, translating lending requirements into SRS documents, functional screens and field specification registers.

Maintain delivery plans, milestones, risks and dependencies across concurrent workstreams and provide structured status reporting to bank and internal stakeholders.

Trained And prepared resources articulate 360 with in the organization foe employees

Led KYC/AML process transformation and re-engineering, analysing onboarding workflows, identifying TAT and manual-review bottlenecks, and implementing process improvements using DMAIC and intelligent automation.

Lead requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, data modelling, data migration planning and go-live readiness for LOS/CRM initiatives.

Partner with business, credit, technology, compliance and regulatory stakeholders to align solution design with banking processes and statutory requirements.

Govern UAT strategy, test cases, defect tracking and sign-off; drive delivery/documentation standards and escalation of risks, issues and open items.

Apply Lean process-improvement and cross-functional mapping to identify workflow enhancements and support adoption of new LOS processes.

Manager – Strategy & Excellence / Business Analyst – Lead Strategy & Excellence | Ummeed Housing Finance Pvt Ltd
May 2025 – Feb 2026 | Gurgaon

Led enterprise digital transformation of the housing-loan lifecycle from login to disbursal, reducing TAT by ~30% and eliminating manual touchpoints across LOS, LMS, CRM and digital communication platforms serving 100K+ active accounts.

Architected transformation roadmaps combining Lean Six Sigma, GenAI analytics and intelligent automation; supported policy, underwriting and audit-report automation.

Worked on end-to-end Customer Onboarding and KYC processes, covering customer information capture, identity/document validation, onboarding controls and downstream underwriting activities.

Governed requirements discovery, BRD/FRD, UAT and multiple concurrent releases, achieving near-zero post-go-live defects across production rollouts.

Owned MIS/KPI governance dashboards for C-suite/board review covering portfolio quality, collections efficiency and customer-service SLAs.

Led stakeholder alignment across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Operations and translated RBI directives into product/process changes.

Led Salesforce CRM migration and governance across legacy/target data structures, mapping rules, workflows, APIs and integrations with Dialer, LMS, LOS and Collections.

Led RBI-compliant VAN implementation, including controls, exception handling and reconciliation logic.

Assistant Manager – Strategic Change & Insights | SBI Cards & Payment Services Ltd.
May 2023 – May 2025 | Gurgaon

Owned requirements for onboarding, KYC, CRM, campaign management and collections platforms supporting millions of cardholders; defined business rules, decisioning and reporting across Credit, Risk and Operations.

Led KYC/AML digital transformation and regulatory change, including Digital KYC journeys using Aadhaar biometric, Face Auth, OTP and Iris Scan.

Partnered with Risk and Compliance on RCSA and ICFR enhancements and regulatory change delivery, strengthening governance and audit readiness.

Designed UAT strategies and executed platform enhancements across compliance, billing and customer-journey domains.

Built SQL/Power BI dashboards for conversion, delinquency and campaign ROI; delivered campaign analytics improvements of ~25%.

Led Lean/Six Sigma and RPA adoption across card operations, including dispute/chargeback workflow automation and conversational AI pilots.

Assistant Manager – Operations Governance & Excellence | Iksula Services Pvt Ltd
Mar 2022 – Dec 2022 | Gurgaon

Built governance frameworks for vendor oversight and operational compliance and implemented process-excellence initiatives reducing redundancies by ~20%.

Applied process excellence and control frameworks to KYC/AML operations, including DMAIC, RCA, RCSA, audit readiness and KPI/control monitoring to improve compliance, quality and onboarding efficiency.

Introduced automation/RPA micro-bots for reporting, cutting weekly MIS manual effort by ~65%.

Conducted DMAIC/RCA on operational gaps and implemented corrective actions and standardized best practices.

Assistant Manager – Global Research & Analytics | Concentrix Services India Pvt Ltd
Nov 2021 – Mar 2022 | Gurgaon

Managed global analytics platforms and delivered data-driven insights supporting vendor negotiations and sourcing strategy.

Leveraged intelligent automation and GenAI for KYC onboarding, including document classification, extraction and validation of identity information, reducing manual review effort and improving onboarding cycle time

Established statistical reporting frameworks for vendor ROI and performance trends and automated BI reporting cycles.

Performed root-cause and key-driver analysis across large-scale customer operations and built executive dashboards for DSAT, contact drivers, sentiment and resolution metrics.

Senior Executive – Process Excellence & Transformation | SBI Cards & Payment Services Ltd.
Jul 2015 – Nov 2021 | Gurgaon

Executed Lean Green Belt/Black Belt projects across customer operations, improving AHT, FCR and CSAT and sustaining improvements through Kaizen, audits and control systems.

Led analysis and redesign of KYC, customer complaints, onboarding, billing, collections and servicing workflows across multi-million cardholder records.

Developed business rules, workflow documentation and MIS reporting used by Compliance and Leadership teams.

Built a consolidated MIS suite replacing 12+ manual reports and improved leadership reporting from a five-day cycle to same-day visibility.

Supported governance, transformation documentation, value-generating roadmaps and early chatbot/NLP automation use cases.

Process Analyst | GE Capital Business Process Management & Services Pvt Ltd
Jul 2013 – Jun 2015 | Gurgaon

Monitored end-to-end process performance using MIS, dashboards and SLA tracking; identified bottlenecks and TAT risks and enabled corrective action.

Performed RCA for process compliance breaches and implemented control improvements across multiple process lines.

Published weekly/monthly leadership reports highlighting process gaps, risk signals and improvement opportunities.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

MBA – Finance & Operations | Amity University

Bachelor of Commerce | Delhi University

CBAP – Certified Business Analysis Professional

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB)

PMP – Project Management Professional

Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

ISO 9001:2015 | Power BI

TECHNOLOGY & TOOLS

SQL • Power BI • Tableau • Advanced Excel • Minitab • Salesforce CRM • JIRA • MS Project • Visio • Draw.io • Miro • GenAI/LLM tools • Conversational AI • RPA • BPMS • API Integrations • UAT/Defect Management

Pradeep Jaiswal | Consolidated CV

sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Project Manager / Senior Business Analyst (Senior Manager) | SysArc Infomatix Pvt Ltd
Apr 2026 – Present | Delhi
Support complex LOS change initiatives for Punjab National Bank across multiple stakeholder groups, translating lending requirements into SRS documents, functional screens and field specification registers.
Maintain delivery plans, milestones, risks and dependencies across concurrent workstreams and provide structured status reporting to bank and internal stakeholders.
Trained And prepared resources articulate 360 with in the organization foe employees
Led KYC/AML process transformation and re-engineering, analysing onboarding workflows, identifying TAT and manual-review bottlenecks, and implementing process improvements using DMAIC and intelligent automation.
Lead requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, data modelling, data migration planning and go-live readiness for LOS/CRM initiatives.
Partner with business, credit, technology, compliance and regulatory stakeholders to align solution design with banking processes and statutory requirements.
Govern UAT strategy, test cases, defect tracking and sign-off; drive delivery/documentation standards and escalation of risks, issues and open items.
Apply Lean process-improvement and cross-functional mapping to identify workflow enhancements and support adoption of new LOS processes.
Manager – Strategy & Excellence / Business Analyst – Lead Strategy & Excellence | Ummeed Housing Finance Pvt Ltd
May 2025 – Feb 2026 | Gurgaon
Led enterprise digital transformation of the housing-loan lifecycle from login to disbursal, reducing TAT by ~30% and eliminating manual touchpoints across LOS, LMS, CRM and digital communication platforms serving 100K+ active accounts.
Architected transformation roadmaps combining Lean Six Sigma, GenAI analytics and intelligent automation; supported policy, underwriting and audit-report automation.
Worked on end-to-end Customer Onboarding and KYC processes, covering customer information capture, identity/document validation, onboarding controls and downstream underwriting activities.
Governed requirements discovery, BRD/FRD, UAT and multiple concurrent releases, achieving near-zero post-go-live defects across production rollouts.
Owned MIS/KPI governance dashboards for C-suite/board review covering portfolio quality, collections efficiency and customer-service SLAs.
Led stakeholder alignment across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Operations and translated RBI directives into product/process changes.
Led Salesforce CRM migration and governance across legacy/target data structures, mapping rules, workflows, APIs and integrations with Dialer, LMS, LOS and Collections.
Led RBI-compliant VAN implementation, including controls, exception handling and reconciliation logic.
Assistant Manager – Strategic Change & Insights | SBI Cards & Payment Services Ltd.
May 2023 – May 2025 | Gurgaon
Owned requirements for onboarding, KYC, CRM, campaign management and collections platforms supporting millions of cardholders; defined business rules, decisioning and reporting across Credit, Risk and Operations.
Led KYC/AML digital transformation and regulatory change, including Digital KYC journeys using Aadhaar biometric, Face Auth, OTP and Iris Scan.
Partnered with Risk and Compliance on RCSA and ICFR enhancements and regulatory change delivery, strengthening governance and audit readiness.
Designed UAT strategies and executed platform enhancements across compliance, billing and customer-journey domains.
Built SQL/Power BI dashboards for conversion, delinquency and campaign ROI; delivered campaign analytics improvements of ~25%.
Led Lean/Six Sigma and RPA adoption across card operations, including dispute/chargeback workflow automation and conversational AI pilots.
Assistant Manager – Operations Governance & Excellence | Iksula Services Pvt Ltd
Mar 2022 – Dec 2022 | Gurgaon
Built governance frameworks for vendor oversight and operational compliance and implemented process-excellence initiatives reducing redundancies by ~20%.
Applied process excellence and control frameworks to KYC/AML operations, including DMAIC, RCA, RCSA, audit readiness and KPI/control monitoring to improve compliance, quality and onboarding efficiency.
Introduced automation/RPA micro-bots for reporting, cutting weekly MIS manual effort by ~65%.
Conducted DMAIC/RCA on operational gaps and implemented corrective actions and standardized best practices.
Assistant Manager – Global Research & Analytics | Concentrix Services India Pvt Ltd
Nov 2021 – Mar 2022 | Gurgaon
Managed global analytics platforms and delivered data-driven insights supporting vendor negotiations and sourcing strategy.
Leveraged intelligent automation and GenAI for KYC onboarding, including document classification, extraction and validation of identity information, reducing manual review effort and improving onboarding cycle time
Established statistical reporting frameworks for vendor ROI and performance trends and automated BI reporting cycles.
Performed root-cause and key-driver analysis across large-scale customer operations and built executive dashboards for DSAT, contact drivers, sentiment and resolution metrics.
Senior Executive – Process Excellence & Transformation | SBI Cards & Payment Services Ltd.
Jul 2015 – Nov 2021 | Gurgaon
Executed Lean Green Belt/Black Belt projects across customer operations, improving AHT, FCR and CSAT and sustaining improvements through Kaizen, audits and control systems.
Led analysis and redesign of KYC, customer complaints, onboarding, billing, collections and servicing workflows across multi-million cardholder records.
Developed business rules, workflow documentation and MIS reporting used by Compliance and Leadership teams.
Built a consolidated MIS suite replacing 12+ manual reports and improved leadership reporting from a five-day cycle to same-day visibility.
Supported governance, transformation documentation, value-generating roadmaps and early chatbot/NLP automation use cases.
Process Analyst | GE Capital Business Process Management & Services Pvt Ltd
Jul 2013 – Jun 2015 | Gurgaon
Monitored end-to-end process performance using MIS, dashboards and SLA tracking; identified bottlenecks and TAT risks and enabled corrective action.
Performed RCA for process compliance breaches and implemented control improvements across multiple process lines.
Published weekly/monthly leadership reports highlighting process gaps, risk signals and improvement opportunities.
